featured_reviews.name: Meenal Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
We discovered Cheerful Mind Academy (CMA)while looking for a preschool near us and enrolled Nurvi in Playgroup and Nursery after being impressed by their curriculum and activity plan. Watching her grow since then has been a joy.

Principal Mrs. Madhavi Morjaria is a gem—she guided us patiently through the entire journey. The teachers and staff are warm and attentive; they notice each child’s strengths and gently work on their weaker spots, bringing everyone forward together. We always got clear updates on class activities, and the coordination with parents felt effortless.

The staff are vigilant and the pickup/ drop protocols are strict without being stressful. The meal timetable is thoughtful and encourages kids to have healthy options.

The year-round activities, competitions, and field trips are creative and genuinely informative. Sports Day and the Annual Day are exceptionally well organised. Most of all, CMA encourages every child and helps them shine.

Thank you, Madhavi ma’am, Dharmesh sir, Harsh sir, and the whole CMA team—you’ve helped Nurvi grow in confidence and curiosity.

To conclude, It's a place where children can thrive, learn, and grow in a loving and supportive environment. We highly recommend this playgroup & nursery school to any parent looking for a quality early childhood education.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dearest Hiral and the Entire Ronak Global Academy  Family!

What an amazing start to the
*Celebrate*Us*
event for toddlers and their families! 🌟

I am truly inspired and deeply honoured to have been the Chief Guest and Judge on such a wonderful platform.

It was not just an event to witness, but a beautiful learning experience for me as well. The creativity, confidence, teamwork, and enthusiasm displayed by everyone were truly commendable.
The entire atmosphere was so creative, energetic, and engaging, filled with pure enthusiasm from start to finish. Seeing the fathers’ involvement was truly spectacular — their excitement and wholehearted participation added a very special charm to the event.

The concept of learning through creativity and teamwork was wonderfully brought alive. Introducing the idea of four houses at this level was such a delightful surprise — something we usually see in higher classes, but executed here with such thoughtful planning and vision.

Everything was superbly organized, reflecting dedication and seamless coordination. The bonding among the teachers and the entire team was evident, creating a beautiful feeling of oneness that radiated throughout the event.

Choosing the winners was extremely difficult — every participant brought something unique and special to the stage. Each effort deserved appreciation, and that made the decision both challenging and meaningful.

Thank you for giving me the opportunity to be part of such a memorable and enriching experience. 🌟👏
Keep Soaring and imparting Knowledge!!!

Best Wishes Always
Mona
